chapters.title: Graphical Representation of Functions
chapters.slo_codes: No SLO codes printed; unit opens with an INTRODUCTION paragraph (PDF 3) instead of a learning-outcome list.
learning_outcomes: sketch quadratic graphs from factorised form; predict a quadratic from its graph
classify algebraic vs transcendental (fundamental / non-fundamental) functions
properties and graphs of exponential functions (domain, continuity, positivity, range, intercepts, monotonicity, injectivity, horizontal asymptote)
define hyperbolic and inverse hyperbolic functions; sketch sinh, cosh; prove identities
properties and graphs of logarithmic functions; vertical asymptote; monotonicity
modulus function graph; graph of inverse via reflection in y = x
shifting and scaling transformations of graphs
solve exponential/logarithmic equations and inequalities with domain checks
applications: growth/decay, sound intensity (decibels), discrete and continuous compound interest
chapters.main_concept: The unit builds graphical literacy for functions: sketching quadratics from factors and reading a quadratic from its graph, then the graphs and analytic properties of exponential, hyperbolic, inverse-hyperbolic, logarithmic and modulus functions. It closes with graph transformations (shift/scale), inverse graphs by reflection in y = x, and solving/ applying exponential-logarithmic equations and inequalities.
